turns.text: Look up the calls planned for 1:30.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls at 1:30.
I mean: take the first one.

turns.text: Find out who that call is with.
turns.rephrase: I mean: see who it is with.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE person_on_call_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: person_on_call_at

turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls with Peggy and count how many there are.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_with

turns.text: With person_on_call_at, work out who I call at 1:30.
turns.rephrase: I mean: use person_on_call_at to find who is on the 1:30 call.

turns.text: Please run count_calls_with for that person and then return it.
turns.rephrase: I mean: count the calls with that person using count_calls_with and then return the number.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE count_calls_for_time_person(time:TIME)
$v0 = CALL person_on_call_at time={time}
$v1 = CALL count_calls_with person=$v0
RETURN $v1
END
turns.name: count_calls_for_time_person
